breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=0.9 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 0.8].
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth corrected the final time T from 0.9 to 0.8 to match the specified time domain `t in [0, 0.8]`. The agent, however, kept the incorrect final time T=0.9 and explicitly stated to override the domain, which is the opposite of the ground truth's resolution.
